cc:Work.dc:title: convexity chords
cc:Work.dc:description: Supplementary invented examples. At midpoint input 1 the square has graph height 1 and chord height 2; the negative square has heights -1 and -2. Convex graphs lie below their chords; concave graphs lie above.
